QUOTE: "Async `entropic.ask` worker | `tasks_` under `tasks_mutex_`; subscribers under `subscribers_mutex_` | **Detached**; never joined" and "`run_async_ask` ... captures `this` and `handle_`, then detaches... So destroying a handle while an async ask is running can let the worker call `entropic_run` on a freed handle"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the async ask worker as the detached, never-joined thread and explains it outlives the bridge/caller scope.
